package.name: claude-freecad-mcp
package.description: Lets Claude Code drive a running FreeCAD. The tools call FreeCAD's own operations, so what they produce is a parametric feature that can be opened and re-dimensioned by hand. Reads the current selection, so a face or edge clicked in FreeCAD can be referred to in the request.
package.author: Aakash Bhatia
